name: Yield Engineering Systems India Pvt ltd
india_angle: The company has a manufacturing facility in Tamil Nadu, India, indicating a strategic presence in the region.
summary: Yield Engineering Systems India Pvt Ltd specializes in providing process engineering equipment and lab-to-fab solutions for the semiconductor industry. Their products enhance the speed, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of semiconductor manufacturing processes. With a global footprint and a significant number of engineers, they serve over 100 fabs worldwide.
